title: Characterizing (role → character)
description: Characterizing produces a character — a stable articulation bearing a χ-nucleus disposition — from a role (a capability-signature) plus an endorsed-behavior set and an optional persona. Generator of the character object (characterizing/library/character). Variance: restriction (a character is the stable cell restricted to an endorsed behavioral fixed-set). Grounded in the lab agentic-characters survey: character = χ-nucleus, role = Σ_R, persona = bearer. Per docs/ORCHESTRATION-GENEALOGY.md.

role.description: a capability-signature: a slug string or an array of capability references
